vulnerabilities.description: Confirmed Regex Injection via DSBL_REJ option. The DSBL_REJ option value is retrieved from database/Option storage and used directly in preg_match() without validation. An attacker who can control this option value can inject malicious regex patterns leading to ReDoS or arbitrary code execution.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Validate regex pattern before use with preg_match('/^.+$/s', $exc) or use a whitelist approach for URL exclusion.

vulnerabilities.description: unserialize() is called on PARAMS option value. While allowed_classes is set to false, the deserialized data structure is not validated before being passed to component execution.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Add structural validation after deserialization to ensure expected array keys exist and contain expected types.

vulnerabilities.description: unserialize() is called on PARAMS option value in OnPageStart handler. The data is used to check $strArParams['BUTTON_SETT'] without validation.
unserialize() called on stored PARAMS option. Admin page requires proper permissions but stored data could be manipulated if database is compromised.
HTTP_REFERER header is stored directly in user consent record without sanitization. This could contain malicious data.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Validate and sanitize HTTP_REFERER before storing.

vulnerabilities.description: getConnection() is used and then RunSQLBatch() is called. SQL batch files should be reviewed for parameterized queries.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Review SQL batch files for proper parameterization.
vulnerabilities.fix: Review install/db/mysql/install.sql and access.sql files for any dynamic SQL construction.

data.summary: Found 6 vulnerabilities in 4 files out of 61 module files analyzed. Maximum severity: high. Main critical vulnerability - Regex Injection via DSBL_REJ option in lib/handlers.php:52, exploitable by users with access to module settings. Also found unsafe deserialization in handlers and options pages, potential information disclosure via HTTP_REFERER, and SQL connection patterns.
